title: Ohio MathCounts
text:
Ohio MathCounts State competition was previously held at the Columbus Community College, but was moved to The Ohio State University Hitchcock Hall for the 2025-2026 season. The 2026 Ohio State Competition took place on 3/7/26.

-Ohio is around a tier 2/tier 3 state

-Jiahe Liu '26 of Beachwood Middle School won the written competition at the MathCounts Nationals Competition in 2022

2026: Nicole Bao, Davin Shao, Aarush Sahoo, Julian Hsiao

2025: Henry Lu (CDR Runner-Up), Andy Mo (CDR Winner), Archishman Dey, Caleb Tan (CDR 3rd Finish)

2024: Arush Krisp, Samuel Joo, Henry Lu, Aryan Agarwal

2023: Alex Zhang, Arush Krisp, Benjamin Jump, Simon Deng

2022: Jiahe Liu, Reese Zong, Devin Zhao, Suvam Konar

2021: Devin Lim, Emir Naduvil, Harshita Ganga, Reese Zong

The state team winners for 2023, 2024, 2025 and 2026 have all been from Solon Middle School, but the coaches for these four years were not all Kendall Daulton of Solon Middle School.

Clarification: there was a scoring error in the system during the 2023 competition that nullified a team member's score. It (incorrectly) had Solon placing 3rd, and upon discovery of this bug, they were recognized as state champions but the old first place team coach was kept as Ohio's coach as it would be quite unfair to them. In 2024, there was an unavoidable conflict the weekend of Nationals that did not permit Daulton to attend. She attended in 2025 and will attend in 2026.
